description: This file contains abstract base class 'GrainDirectoryTests' defining unit tests for custom 'IGrainDirectory' implementations in Orleans. It includes test methods for register, lookup, and unregister operations with various scenarios.

classes.name: GrainDirectoryTests
classes.description: An abstract generic test class for testing implementations of IGrainDirectory, providing common test scenarios like register, lookup, unregister, and overwrite checks.

methods.name: RegisterLookupUnregisterLookup
methods.description: Tests registering a grain address, looking it up, and then unregistering it, ensuring correct behavior.

methods.name: DoNotOverwriteEntry
methods.description: Tests that registering a new address for the same grain ID without overwrite conditions returns the existing address, preventing overwrites.

methods.name: OverwriteEntryIfMatch
methods.description: Tests that registering a new address with matching previous address succeeds in overwriting, while mismatched previous address prevents overwriting.

methods.name: DoNotDeleteDifferentActivationIdEntry
methods.description: Ensures that unregistering an entry with a different activation ID does not delete the existing registration.

methods.name: LookupNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that looking up a non-existent grain ID returns null.
